_instructions: Manual source of truth for StreamCloud recommendations. Add objects to movies or series; no movie metadata API or API key is used.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.overview: A struggling family gradually becomes entangled with a wealthy household, setting off a tense story of class, ambition, and unexpected consequences.
movies.note: A tightly constructed social thriller with dark humour.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.overview: A young girl enters a mysterious spirit world and must find courage and resourcefulness to rescue her parents and return home.

movies.title: Inception
movies.overview: A specialist who enters people's dreams is offered a chance to clear his past by carrying out an unusually difficult mission inside a target's mind.
movies.note: A layered science-fiction thriller built around dreams and memory.

series.title: Dark
series.overview: A disappearance in a small German town reveals connections between several families and a mystery that stretches across generations and time.
series.note: Best watched attentively; its timelines and family connections matter.

series.title: Money Heist
series.overview: A meticulous criminal known as the Professor recruits a team for a high-stakes heist, while plans, loyalties, and relationships are repeatedly tested.
series.note: A fast-paced heist drama with shifting alliances.

series.title: Breaking Bad
series.overview: After a serious diagnosis, a chemistry teacher turns to producing illegal drugs to secure his family's future, setting off a gradual transformation with far-reaching consequences.
series.note: A character-driven crime drama with carefully built tension.

series.title: Game of Thrones
series.overview: Noble families fight for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne while an ancient threat rises beyond the Wall.
series.note: An expansive fantasy epic of power, political intrigue, and shifting alliances.

series.title: House of the Dragon
series.overview: Set nearly two centuries before Game of Thrones, the Targaryen dynasty faces a bitter succession struggle that threatens to tear the realm apart.
series.note: A dragon-filled political drama about succession, family, and power.

series.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
series.overview: A century before Game of Thrones, the wandering knight Ser Duncan the Tall and his young squire Egg travel through Westeros and encounter adventures that test their courage and friendship.
series.note: A more grounded Westeros adventure focused on Dunk and Egg.
